notes: Step 1 parts were correct, so none were added or dropped.
Breadboard positions are read from the circuit image. The potentiometer straddles the centre gap: its wiper pin is in column 12, top half (12t.f), and its two outer pins are in 11b.e and 13b.e.
The yellow wire from A0 ends in 12t.g, the same strip as the wiper. The black wire goes to 11b.d (the GND side) and the red wire to 13b.d (the 5V side).
The black wire goes to the second GND pin in the Uno power header. I mapped it to GND.2; any Uno GND is equivalent.
The potentiometer's outer pins are symmetric, so which one is GND and which is VCC doesn't matter electrically.
The USB cable and computer are not part of the drawn circuit and are left out.
